content.comment_body: Hello, I am [user_name], an Italian student. I am trying to use a [product_name]. I wrote a simple program using [product_name] V8, and after simulation, I attempted to transfer the program from PC to [product_name]. The process did not work, and I received an error message (translated to English): 'Cannot perform the transfer because the connected device is not compatible. To see which devices are available for your program, check the select devices dialog box.' I checked this dialog, but only see [product_name] listed. Other functions, such as switching from STOP to RUN mode, work fine from the PC. Is there a problem with my program? Thanks

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. The problem seems to be that the device selected in the software does not match your actual hardware. You did not mention the exact model you have. Please provide: - The precise article number of your device. - The firmware version. - The version of [product_name] Soft Comfort you are using.

Hello, thanks for the help. I am using V8 of [product_name] Soft Comfort, but I also tried V7. My device is [article_no]. I am unsure whether it is the standard model or another version included in the [article_no] folder. When using version 7, the PC to device transfer starts, but at 11% the software stops responding or closes.
Try using all ES versions of [article_no] to see if any work for your situation.
Alternatively, use [product_name] V8.0 and check the firmware version: Tools > Transfer > Show FW version.
Hello, I followed that step and captured the process. After starting the download, the software stalls at the same percentage and does not progress.
The download process begins but never completes.
Which cable are you using? Is it an original [company_name] USB cable or a third-party replica? Or perhaps an original [company_name] RS232 cable paired with a USB converter?
Yes, it is a cable from [product_name] RS232 to USB. The box contained a CD with drivers as well. The cable is labeled '[company_name]'.
I also use an original [company_name] RS232 cable with a USB to RS232 converter, which does not need additional drivers. I have not encountered any issues.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter compatibility problems between their hardware and the device profile selected within [product_name] Soft Comfort while transferring programs. Various attempts to resolve the issue, including changing software versions and device profiles, yield limited or no progress. Transfer failures and software freezing continue, indicating an unclear troubleshooting process and the need for better guidance assisting users in matching software selections properly to their hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth compatibility between [product_name] Soft Comfort and their connected device, enabling successful program transfers and providing clear instructions when problems arise.
